winterCamp.aboutDescription:
The Winter Training Camp for the Palestinian Mathematics Olympiad was launched on Saturday, 10/1/2026, and continued for six days, hosted generously by Al-Istiqlal University in the city of Jericho, where the camp concluded successfully.

A total of 53 male and female students from 18 directorates participated in the camp. They were selected through a rigorous multi-stage selection process that began at the school level with the participation of more than 5,000 students. This was followed by 1,046 students advancing to the directorate level, then a pre-final stage that included 140 students, culminating in a final stage of 53 students representing 18 directorates.

The camp hosted international academics and supervisors specialized in international and Arab mathematics Olympiads, alongside local academics from several Palestinian universities, who dedicated their time and expertise to enhancing the students’ academic level during this stage.

The training team also included supervisors from various directorates of the Palestinian Ministry of Education and Higher Education, who contributed to the success of the camp and the achievement of its educational and academic objectives.

imoNews.title: Palestine at the 67th International Mathematical Olympiad — Shanghai, China 2026
imoNews.description:
The Palestinian national mathematics team represented Palestine at the 67th International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2026), hosted by the city of Shanghai in the People's Republic of China, alongside teams of the world's most talented young mathematicians.
The team consisted of six students selected through the stages of the Palestinian Mathematics Olympiad, accompanied by team leaders from among the Palestinian university professors specialized in mathematics who supervised their preparation and training.
During the opening ceremony, the Palestinian team took the stage and raised the flag of Palestine among the participating countries, in a moment that reflects the ability of Palestinian students to be present in the most prestigious international scientific forums.
The participation comes within the activities of the Palestinian Mathematics Olympiad, implemented in cooperation with Taawon, the Ministry of Education and Higher Education, and Palestine Academy for Science and Technology, as part of a continuous effort to sustain Palestine's representation in international competitions.
Below are moments from the journey, documented in photos and videos, from departure to the opening ceremony and the days of the Olympiad.

news.title: Mathematics Supervisors Training within the Palestinian Mathematics Olympiad
news.description:
As part of the Palestinian Mathematics Olympiad activities, which is implemented in cooperation with the Cooperation Foundation, a training session for mathematics supervisors was held over two days (29–30 of last month).
The event took place physically at Al-Hilal Hotel in Ramallah, with the participation of 20 supervisors from the Ministry of Education, in addition to 8 supervisors from Gaza via video conferencing.
The training focused on empowering supervisors with methods to integrate Olympiad culture into classrooms and enhance mathematical thinking and problem-solving skills among students.
National team trainers, who are university professors specialized in mathematics, delivered training across the four Olympiad domains and explained the international training framework.
Discussions with supervisors helped define strategies to integrate Olympiad culture into school curricula.
In conclusion, Dr. Mohammed Khalil thanked all partners including the Ministry of Education and Palestine Academy for Science and Technology.
